items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1969-06-17
items.q: When Ness was drinking all that wine around, you know what I mean? Yeah, I got him for me. Yeah. So the fellas always get, I hired anybody, man, I hired anybody, man. I hired all them fellas over there, man. All them fellas.

ctx.x: You know everybody played different you know.

Everybody played alike you know. That's why I tell you you've got to get an acquaintance for him. You see what I mean? You've got one style you've got to work the other style you see? So you've got to get acquainted with your style. See? How come you just went to see him and offered him a job with your band or you heard him play much or what? No I tell you look, most of the time I tell you most of the time I meet a man you know, whether them boy live over over over over over over over over over over over over…
The ones that we're talking about, what you're doing?
